start: Member page with dues, a payment company connected, member has a mobile number

steps.action: Tap Collect, then in Pay online tap Make a payment link
user_sees: 'Making the link…'
A QR code of the payment link
'Scan with the phone camera to pay by UPI, card or net banking on {name}.'
must_not: Two live links for the same dues
A link for a different amount from the one shown

user_sees: WhatsApp with '{payee}: please pay {amount} for {label}. Pay here: {url}'
must_not: Another member's name or amount in the message

steps.action: The member pays; tap Check or wait for the 10-minute check
user_sees: 'Receipt saved.'
must_not: A receipt saved twice
The payment saved as cash

start: Member page with dues, the gym's UPI ID saved in Settings, Payments

user_sees: UPI QR code to pay {amount}
'Scan with any UPI app: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or BHIM.'
'When the money shows in your UPI app or sound box, tap Save payment.'
must_not: A UPI ID the owner did not set

steps.action: Money shows in the sound box; tap Save payment
user_sees: Payment saved; the request is done and any company link for it is closed
must_not: The member still able to pay the old link
A payment made online a moment ago saved again as cash

start: Member page with dues, the member uses the MettleUp app

user_sees: 'Sent. They see it under My membership in the MettleUp app. Tap Save payment when the money shows.'
must_not: The request reaching another member's app

steps.action: Ask for a payment link for a member with no mobile number
user_sees: '{name} needs the member’s mobile number for a payment link. Add it to the member, or show the UPI QR.'
must_not: A link made without a number
The UPI QR hidden too

user_sees: The request refused (BAD_AMOUNT)
must_not: A ₹0 link sent to a member

steps.action: No internet; tap Make a payment link
user_sees: 'No internet. Try again.'
must_not: A spinner that never ends

start: A payment link sent, member has not paid

steps.action: Change the amount and make a new link
user_sees: A new link; the old one is asked once, then closed at the company
must_not: The member able to pay both links

user_sees: The request shows cancelled
must_not: A payment that already happened hidden by the cancel

start: Paid online, receipt not made (the automatic receipt failed)

steps.action: Open Paid online, receipt not made
user_sees: 'These members paid online, but the receipt could not be made by itself. Save each payment by hand, then tap I saved it.'
'{name} paid {amount} online'
must_not: A test-mode payment counted as money
A refunded payment offered for a receipt

user_sees: The line goes away
must_not: The same payment saved twice by two desks

start: Payments switched on, PAY_LIVE off (test mode)

user_sees: 'Test mode: no real money moves.'
must_not: A test payment saved as a real receipt

user_sees: Connect, Paste keys and Disconnect buttons; the keys are never shown back
must_not: The company keys shown on screen
